# Evaluate a copied signing configuration before selecting entitlement paths

Fresh full signing/repackage port read. The historical transform deep-copies hardened-sign-config before keyed evaluation because evaluation can mutate the source. It asserts a primary dependency, selects production signing only for production shippable jobs, resolves per-entry entitlements by build platform/project and converts local entitlement paths to file URLs. These are exact configuration/data-flow changes, not proof the underlying signing service executed. Both repackage kinds now select notarization only for macosx64-shippable at production release level; staging and other platforms use signing. Fixed kind files retain those selected branches. The fixed comm hardened-signing module is a later wrapper after the Gecko transform and removes provisioning-profile configuration; the historical local implementation is no longer current there. Upstream transform implementation and its later evolution were not inspected. The full Bug explicitly says no automated coverage and no Daily verification at uplift request, while suggesting macOS partial-update QA. Review suggests splitting the other upstream port for traceability, explicitly nonblocking and with uncertainty about norms; it does not establish a global split-port rule. No task generation, signing/notarization, repackage, partial update or QA ran.

Scope: macOS signing keyed configuration isolation.
